## Public gathering application (draft)

- **Organizer:** [YOUR GROUP NAME]
- **Location:** Grand Parade, Barrington St side
- **When:** Sat 6–8 PM
- **Attendance:** ~800 people
- **Activity:** Candlelight vigil, 3 short speeches, no march
- **Sound:** One battery speaker, off by 8 PM
- **Safety plan:** 6 marshals, 2 medics, 1 legal observer; warming tent at stage

### Questions for the city
1. Are open flames (candles) allowed on the square?
2. Is a noise permit needed for one speaker?

checklist.item: Confirm whether a noise permit is needed
Brief marshals on zones and exit plan
Post official update account in event description
Pack warming tent, blankets, hand warmers
Set up warming tent at stage before start
Walk the Barrington St exit; keep lane clear
Radio / group-chat check with all volunteers
Clean-up sweep for wax and litter

route_notes: No march: people gather on Grand Parade and leave the same way. The Barrington St side is the only east exit and becomes a choke point when the crowd leaves at once; keep a marshal there and a clear lane. Use the George St side as a second exit if attendance passes 600. Disperse in waves after the last speech and remind people that buses on Barrington may be detoured.
